states that when a channel is archived while archived channels are NOT viewable, the user is removed from it (and kicked out if it is the current channel); when viewable, the channel is kept and marked deleted
decisions.detail: QUOTE: When a channel is archived over the websocket and the setting is off, the app kicks the user out if that channel is current (`handleKickFromChannel` with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`) and removes the user's membership. When on, the membership is kept. | WHY: The answer covers removal and kick-out when not viewable, but it only says membership is "kept" when viewable. It never says the channel is marked deleted (delete_at set) in the websocket case, and the local archiveChannel row doesn't cover the websocket handler either. || QUOTE: When a channel is archived over the websocket and the setting is off, the app kicks the user out if that channel is current (`handleKickFromChannel` with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`) and removes the user's membership. When on, the membership is kept. | WHY: The answer covers the removal and kick when the setting is off. It only says membership is kept when on and never says the channel is marked deleted. || QUOTE: "When a channel is archived over the websocket and the setting is off, the app kicks the user out if that channel is current (`handleKickFromChannel` with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`) and removes the user's membership.
